members: public TelemetryPipelineWiring(TelemetryEventBus eventBus, ReorderingService reorderingService, EventLogService eventLogService) { this.eventBus = eventBus; this.reorderingService = reorderingService; this.eventLogService = eventLogService; }

@PreDestroy public void stop() { if (recordSubscription != null) { recordSubscription.dispose(); recordSubscription = null; } if (reconcileSubscription != null) { reconcileSubscription.dispose(); reconcileSubscription = null; } }
